In the event of a tie, this market will resolve to the team officially recognized by Superettan (Sweden) as finishing in third place. If multiple teams are officially awarded third place, the market will resolve to the team whose listed name comes first alphabetically.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed club to finish 3rd in the 2026 Superettan (Sweden) season, the market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026 Superettan (Sweden) season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no 3rd place team declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source will be official information from Superettan (Sweden). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
